method.coverage: dependency-free direct WOFF2 directory/Brotli/cmap format 4/12/13 parser; independent of fontTools cmap
method.shaping: JDK 23 java.desktop HarfBuzz 8.2.2 through RTL Font.layoutGlyphVector with sun.font.layout.ffm=true
method.sfntReconstruction: fontTools reconstructs a temporary unflavored full SFNT from each unchanged WOFF2; no tables are subset, stripped, renamed, or written into the repository
method.markAnchorDetection: each combining-mark character must produce a glyph-ID-nonzero, zero-advance glyph with nonzero x/y positioning inside ±2 UPEM
method.advanceAndOffsetSemantics: advance is the nominal glyph advance supplied to HarfBuzz; offset is the shaped origin relative to the same glyph sequence without layout; mark offsets are direct GPOS evidence because mark advances are zero
